Same 740 student frames from 20 starts; same 40k endpoint. 1,200 episodes on 100 new cases per suite.
Intervals resample shared case clusters, conditional on these three trained models; they are not training-seed population intervals.
The full window also reduces early-frame density, so the causal mechanism is not isolated.

Three seeds × two arms, each +20k supervised updates to 60k; 1,800 episodes on 100 shared physical initial cases.
Top dots are per-seed rates; bottom whiskers are paired 95% case-cluster intervals conditional on the six fixed models.
Synthetic RGB multiplication only. The clean-cost gate failed; the augmented models do not replace the normal models.

1,000 updates per mode; fixed real batch, same initial weights, synchronized metrics. Torch compiled throughput is 13.8% below JAX.
Torch end MPS tensors / driver allocation: eager 55.6 / 138.7 MiB; compiled 55.6 / 82.6 MiB. JAX GPU allocation was not measured.
Unified-memory RSS and MPS counters overlap: do not sum them. Proxy snapshots include GUI/background work, not kernel occupancy.
One run per mode in a fixed order; no frequency/temperature lock. This fixed-batch memory excludes the full offline training dataset.
